item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.29

  • Clean Desktop has a stage: the Poster, a Spinning Vinyl with its tonearm, or Clock & Up Next with your next event today. Pick one from the notch's right-click menu or Settings → Clean Desktop.
  • Hold ⌥ while Clean Desktop is on and your files come back, so you can drag one out. Let go and they step aside again.
  • Idle Curtain: step away for a few minutes and the stage comes up over everything. Move the pointer or press a key and it's gone. It stays down during video calls, presentations and films, and you can change the wait or switch it off in Settings.
  • The record in the notch keeps its place when the notch closes, and turns in step with the one on your desktop.
